memory_materialization_rule: Explicit event participants alone receive bilateral memory. Group co-presence does not broadcast private knowledge. Personal state is evidence-grounded and cannot directly write hard-world facts. Consequential behavior defaults normal absent supplied trigger evidence. Family age alone cannot create health/care/marriage/fertility/conflict. Storyteller is read-only: chronology is not causality, candidate lifecycle links are stronger than temporal adjacency, and every interpretation requires ledger evidence.
